notes:
Fieldbook 1.4.0: plan and notes multi-select, resizable Gantt columns, own time picker, month side panel, multi-area filter, custom area colours

- Master plan: group pencil selects work packages, sub-activities and milestones;
  move dates by days/weeks/months (linked tasks follow), bulk edit start/end,
  parent, progress source/value, deliverable and resources; delete with Undo
- Notes: group pencil in Today, Month and Notes; move date, area, tags, delete
- Gantt: drag the Work package, Deliverable and Resources column edges; widths
  saved per device, double-click resets
- Phone/tablet: Fieldbook time picker replaces the system clock dialog
- Month view: day tasks, routines and notes in a right-hand panel on PC/tablet
- Areas: show several areas together (More/⋯ picker, Ctrl-click); any colour
